about: Mutation receipts (TESTING.md rule 6, mechanical form - /correct Phase 3 round (b), class N1). Every new or changed check (proof, drive, selftest, fixture suite) and every changed gate judge ships with a receipt here: the deliberate break it was observed failing under (a mutation of the current tree, the historical tree carrying the real past mistake, or - kind 'rendered', honestly labelled - a rendered/manual measurement), the failing observation, and the clean pass. Each receipt pins the sha256 of every file its evidence depends on; scripts/check-receipts.py verifies currency, and scripts/push.py refuses a push whose changed check/judge files no current receipt names. Receipts are append-only history: a re-observation gets a new id. Issue with: python3 scripts/check-receipts.py issue <root> --id ID --check PATH --kind mutation|historical|rendered --mutation TEXT --red TEXT --green TEXT --issued ROUND --file PATH...
